title: Beta
shortDescription: Build Swiggy Instamart carts by voice or text, then review before checkout.
fullDescription:
Beta is a cart-only assistant for Swiggy Instamart. Speak or type a grocery list and Beta helps you find available products, review the proposed changes and add only the items you confirm. Voice and text work together, so you can switch between them at any time.

Connect your Swiggy account through Swiggy's secure sign-in page. Beta can show your saved delivery addresses and recent Instamart choices. With optional location permission, your phone can use your current location to rank nearby saved addresses. Raw GPS coordinates stay on your phone. You always choose and confirm the delivery address, and Beta reads a short address confirmation aloud when text-to-speech is available.

Beta searches the address-specific Instamart catalogue, uses recent product choices to rank relevant live results, and shows the exact cart plan before making any change. After you confirm an update, Beta checks back to see whether the change stayed, which can take about a minute. If Beta still cannot safely tell whether the cart update can be distinguished from the existing cart, it stops and asks you to inspect Swiggy yourself instead of retrying automatically. Beta never checks out or places an order.

Beta never places an order, completes checkout or makes a payment. It does not see your Swiggy OTP or payment details, and it does not store raw voice audio. You review the cart and complete checkout yourself in Swiggy.

Optional analytics are off by default. If you opt in, Beta records only pseudonymous reliability signals and timing for improving the app. Those coarse install, activation, verified-cart and return events may also support Google Ads conversion measurement when the account setup is enabled. Grocery requests, products, cart contents, saved addresses, raw GPS and other shopping payloads are never sent to analytics or ads. You can turn analytics off again in Settings.
